sentences.zh: 现在，如果你从习近平的角度来看，你看到的是他所说的对中国的全方位遏制。

sentences.en: They came into office saying that they were going to rebuild their partnerships and alliances with other countries after the Trump era.
sentences.zh: 他看到了美国对中国的这种包围。

sentences.en: And in a way, that's exactly what they've done.
sentences.zh: 他觉得他需要走向世界，以巩固中国在全球的影响力，加强其最强大的伙伴关系，

sentences.en: And these countries, places like Japan or the Philippines, are completely on board with this because they see China as a potential threatening military act or two.
sentences.zh: 并与世界上一些最重要的地区的国家建立联系。

sentences.en: And they want to be able to have deterrence against China.
sentences.zh: 我们稍后回来。

sentences.en: And they see a partnership with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: as one of the best ways of going about doing that.
sentences.zh: 作为实现这一目标的最优途径之一。

sentences.en: Now, if you're looking at this from Xi's perspective, you're seeing what he calls all-around containment of China.
sentences.zh: 现在，如果你站在习近平的角度来看，你会看到他所说的对中国的全方位遏制。

sentences.en: He sees this encirclement of China by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他认为这是美国对中国的包围。

sentences.en: And he feels he needs to get out there in the world in order to shore up China's influence around the globe, in order to strengthen its most powerful partners,
sentences.zh: 他觉得必须走向世界，以巩固中国在全球的影响力，加强与最强有力伙伴的关系，

sentences.en: and in order to build up ties with countries in some of the most important parts of the world.
sentences.zh: 并与世界上一些最重要地区的国家建立联系。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: And I love a one-pan recipe because I don't love washing pans.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢一锅出的食谱，因为我不喜欢洗锅。

sentences.en: The New York Times, celebrating 175 years of helping you understand the world and make the most of each day.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》，庆祝成立175周年，致力于帮助您了解世界，充实每一天。

sentences.en: Subscribe now for a special offer at nytimes.com slash subscribe.
sentences.zh: 立即订阅，访问 nytimes.com/subscribe 享受特别优惠。

sentences.en: Ed, walk us through the steps Xi has taken over the past few weeks to build up ties and shore up its influence around the world.
sentences.zh: 埃德，请为我们梳理一下习近平在过去几周里采取的步骤，以建立联系并巩固其在全球的影响力。

sentences.en: At this moment, when the U.S.
sentences.zh: 此时此刻，当美国

sentences.en: has taken all these actions to counter China.
sentences.zh: 采取了所有这些行动来对抗中国时。

sentences.en: Well, one of the most striking diplomatic actions that China took just happened 10 days ago.
sentences.zh: 嗯，中国在仅仅10天前采取的最引人注目的外交行动之一刚刚发生。

sentences.en: This was when China hosted leaders from Iran and from Saudi Arabia in Beijing to sign an important diplomatic agreement to reopen relations with each other.
sentences.zh: 当时中国在北京接待了来自伊朗和沙特阿拉伯的领导人，签署了一项重要的外交协议，以恢复双方关系。

sentences.en: And that was a big deal because Iran and Saudi Arabia are longtime rivals.
sentences.zh: 这是一件大事，因为伊朗和沙特阿拉伯是长期的竞争对手。

sentences.en: There has been increasing hostilities between these two countries.
sentences.zh: 这两个国家之间的敌意日益加剧。

sentences.en: And officials around the world even fear that they could get involved in a nuclear arms race sometime soon.
sentences.zh: 世界各地的官员甚至担心他们可能很快就会卷入核军备竞赛。

sentences.en: And now here was China, which has growing ties to both of these countries,
sentences.zh: 而现在，与这两个国家关系日益密切的中国，

sentences.en: stepping in and trying to make some sort of initial steps toward peace take place between the two nations.
sentences.zh: 介入其中，并试图在两国之间采取一些初步的和平步骤。

sentences.en: Ed, you don't normally think of China as a mediator in the Middle East, right?
sentences.zh: 埃德，你通常不会认为中国是中东的调解人，对吧？

sentences.en: You think of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你想到的是美国。

sentences.en: So why was China doing this?
sentences.zh: 那么中国为什么要这样做呢？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: China has not played a very proactive role in diplomacy in the region.
sentences.zh: 中国在该地区的外交中并没有发挥非常积极的作用。

sentences.en: But in recent years, it's had growing interests across the Middle East and especially with countries in the Gulf area.
sentences.zh: 但近年来，它在整个中东，特别是与海湾地区国家的利益日益增长。

sentences.en: So it imports around 40 percent of its oil from the region.
sentences.zh: 它从该地区进口了约40%的石油。

sentences.en: And both Iran and Saudi Arabia are the two biggest sellers of oil to China.
sentences.zh: 伊朗和沙特阿拉伯都是中国最大的两个石油供应国。

sentences.en: So China needs to make sure that there's stability in the area.
sentences.zh: 因此，中国需要确保该地区的稳定。

sentences.en: So here, what we're seeing is China willing to step in and play mediator in order to ensure that stability.
sentences.zh: 所以在这里，我们看到的是中国愿意介入并担任调解人，以确保这种稳定。

sentences.en: It's unclear whether China will be able to do that, but it's trying to make itself into a more important player.
sentences.zh: 目前尚不清楚中国是否能够做到这一点，但它正在努力使自己成为一个更重要的参与者。

sentences.en: And in some ways, as you point out, stepping into the type of role that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，正如你所指出的，它正在介入美国

sentences.en: has played in the region.
sentences.zh: 在该地区所扮演的角色。

sentences.en: Now, in this case, China was a much more logical mediator than the U.S.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，中国比美国更合乎逻辑地成为了调解人。

sentences.en: The U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: would not be able to accomplish what China had just done because the U.S.
sentences.zh: 无法完成中国刚刚所做的事情，因为美国

sentences.en: doesn't have formal diplomatic relations with Iran.
sentences.zh: 与伊朗没有正式的外交关系。

sentences.en: China, on the other hand, has diplomatic relations with both countries.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，中国与这两个国家都有外交关系。

sentences.en: And in fact, its ties with both of them are growing stronger by the month.
sentences.zh: 事实上，它与两者的关系每个月都在加强。

sentences.en: So China has powers that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以中国拥有美国

sentences.en: doesn't have.
sentences.zh: 所不具备的力量。

sentences.en: Namely, it has relations with Iran and it can, in some ways, look like the adult in the room in the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 即它与伊朗有关系，并且在某种程度上，它可以看起来像是中东地区那个成熟稳重的大国。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And there's another important goal that China has in the region, and that is expanding its military footprint.
sentences.zh: 中国在该地区还有另一个重要目标，那就是扩大其军事足迹。

sentences.en: And we know that they've been trying to get access to parts of the Gulf region in order to establish a military base.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，他们一直试图进入海湾地区的部分地区，以建立军事基地。

sentences.en: U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国

sentences.en: officials have pushed back against that, and they've been trying to get countries in the region to promise that they will not give China military access.
sentences.zh: 官员们对此进行了反击，他们一直试图让该地区国家承诺不会给予中国军事准入。

sentences.en: And has China gotten military access?
sentences.zh: 那么中国获得军事准入了吗？

sentences.en: So far, China has not been able to build a base in the region, but U.S.
sentences.zh: 到目前为止，中国还无法在该地区建立基地，但美国

sentences.en: officials are watching closely for whether it will try to do that.
sentences.zh: 官员们正在密切关注它是否会尝试这样做。

sentences.en: So the Biden administration carefully watching it.
sentences.zh: 所以拜登政府在密切关注它。

sentences.en: The Biden administration presumably also carefully watching this week's visit by Xi to Moscow.
sentences.zh: 拜登政府大概也在密切关注习近平本周对莫斯科的访问。

sentences.en: How exactly does this visit fit into the broader framework you're describing of China pushing back and shoring up itself against the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 这次访问究竟如何符合你所描述的中国反击并巩固自身以对抗美国的更广泛框架？

sentences.en: Well, as you know, China and Russia have had longstanding ties.
sentences.zh: 嗯，如你所知，中国和俄罗斯有着长期的联系。

sentences.en: There's a whole range of interests that they share.
sentences.zh: 他们有着广泛的共同利益。

sentences.en: For example, China imports a lot of Russian oil, as it does from the Middle EaSt.
sentences.zh: 例如，中国进口大量俄罗斯石油，就像它从中东进口一样。

sentences.en: It also has many close security arrangements with Russia.
sentences.zh: 它也与俄罗斯有许多密切的安全安排。

sentences.en: The two militaries do join exercises together.
sentences.zh: 两国军队确实会进行联合演习。

sentences.en: They've done that several times this year.
sentences.zh: 今年他们已经进行了几次。

sentences.en: But perhaps the biggest significance of this visit is that it's meant to reinforce this worldview that officials and leaders in both Beijing and Moscow have and that Xi and Putin have both highlighted.
sentences.zh: 但这次访问最重要的意义可能在于，它旨在加强北京和莫斯科的官员和领导人所持有的，以及习近平和普京都强调的世界观。

sentences.en: And that is that they see the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那就是他们视美国

sentences.en: as their biggest shared rival or adversary on the world stage and that they believe that together they can present a united front to push back against U.S.
sentences.zh: 为他们在世界舞台上共同的最大竞争对手或敌手，并且他们相信，他们可以共同组成统一战线来反击美国

sentences.en: dominance in the world.
sentences.zh: 在世界上的主导地位。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They share this one very important thing, a frustration with American power and with how America wields that power.
sentences.zh: 他们有一个非常重要的共同点，那就是对美国的力量以及美国如何运用这种力量感到沮丧。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And the leaders in both countries are very explicit about that.
sentences.zh: 两国领导人都对此表达得非常明确。

sentences.en: But we also don't want to overstate how closely their general worldviews are aligned.
sentences.zh: 但我们也不想夸大他们的一般世界观在多大程度上是一致的。

sentences.en: For example, the fact that Putin operates in many ways as a chaos agent in different parts of the world and obviously most recently in this invasion of Ukraine,
sentences.zh: 例如，普京在世界不同地区，显然最近在入侵乌克兰这件事上，在许多方面表现得像一个混乱制造者，

sentences.en: that's something that China is not entirely happy about.
sentences.zh: 这是中国并不完全高兴的事情。

sentences.en: China sees the international order and the global economy as important for its rise in the world, as important for powering its economic engine.
sentences.zh: 中国认为国际秩序和全球经济对其在世界上的崛起很重要，对其驱动经济引擎很重要。

sentences.en: And the more that Putin does to disrupt all of that, the worse it is for China.
sentences.zh: 普京破坏这一切的行为越多，对中国就越不利。

sentences.en: China now has to deal with a whole range of sanctions on Russia.
sentences.zh: 中国现在必须应对针对俄罗斯的一系列制裁。

sentences.en: It has to rework its trade ties.
sentences.zh: 它必须重新调整其贸易关系。

sentences.en: And it also has to deal with the fluctuations in global energy prices and in other parts of the world economy because of what Putin is doing.
sentences.zh: 而且由于普京的行为，它还必须应对全球能源价格和其他世界经济领域的波动。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Not something that Xi really wants to be dealing with.
sentences.zh: 这不是习近平真正想处理的事情。

sentences.en: So there is some incentive then for China to play the role of peacemaker in Ukraine, which is how China is describing this trip.
sentences.zh: 因此，中国确实有一些动机在乌克兰扮演和平缔造者的角色，这也是中国对这次访问的描述。

sentences.en: That's right, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 没错，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: There is some incentive.
sentences.zh: 确实有一些动机。

sentences.en: But so far, what they've proposed or the statements they've made don't give U.S.
sentences.zh: 但到目前为止，他们提出的建议或发表的声明并没有给美国

sentences.en: and some European officials a lot of confidence.
sentences.zh: 和一些欧洲官员带来太多的信心。

sentences.en: We don't see China making the commitments or asking Putin to withdraw his troops, which U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们没有看到中国做出承诺或要求普京撤军，而美国

sentences.en: officials say would lead to an authentic and durable peace in Ukraine.
sentences.zh: 官员们表示，那才会导致乌克兰实现真正且持久的和平。

sentences.en: So it's a peacemaking mission in words only?
sentences.zh: 所以这只是口头上的和平使命吗？

sentences.en: Well, when I talk with U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，当我与美国

sentences.en: officials and some analysts here in Washington,
sentences.zh: 官员和华盛顿的一些分析人士交谈时，

sentences.en: they say that what might be happening is that Xi and his colleagues in Beijing are presenting a cover story for their real intentions on this visit to Russia.
sentences.zh: 他们说，可能发生的情况是，习近平和他在北京的同事们正在为他们此次俄罗斯之行的真实意图提供一个掩护故事。

sentences.en: So it sounds good to the world that they're on a peace mission to try and end the Ukraine war.
sentences.zh: 所以向世界宣称他们正在进行旨在结束乌克兰战争的和平使命，听起来不错。

sentences.en: But what these two leaders are really doing in Moscow is to shore up relations between their two countries to talk about how the two nations can cooperate on a whole range of issues because each sees the other as indispensable in being able to push back against the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但这两位领导人在莫斯科真正做的是巩固两国之间的关系，讨论两国如何在广泛的问题上进行合作，因为双方都视对方为能够反击美国

sentences.en: on all kinds of fronts, whether that's in trade, in technology and in military terms, too.
sentences.zh: 在各个方面（无论是贸易、技术还是军事方面）不可或缺的伙伴。

sentences.en: So, Ed, you're describing a very complex set of alliances that Xi is trying to weave in light of what he sees as mounting pressure on him by the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以，埃德，你描述的是习近平试图编织的一套非常复杂的联盟，鉴于他认为美国对他施加的压力越来越大。

sentences.en: So to get back to the beginning of our conversation, when you quoted Xi's statement, you know, which used language from the Cold War era,
sentences.zh: 回到我们谈话的开始，当你引用习近平的声明时，你知道，他使用了冷战时期的语言，

sentences.en: are we seeing the beginnings of a new kind of Cold War with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们是否正在看到一种新型冷战的开端，即美国

sentences.en: and its allies on one side and China and its allies on the other?
sentences.zh: 及其盟友在一边，而中国及其盟友在另一边？

sentences.en: Well, Sabrina, people keep asking that question, but I think it's much more complicated than that.
sentences.zh: 嗯，萨布丽娜，人们一直在问这个问题，但我认为这比那复杂得多。

sentences.en: All these countries, whether it's the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所有这些国家，无论是美国

sentences.en: or its European allies or its allies in Asia, they all have very close trade ties to China.
sentences.zh: 还是其欧洲盟友或亚洲盟友，它们都与中国有着非常密切的贸易联系。

sentences.en: China is, in many cases, the biggest trading partner for some of these countries.
sentences.zh: 在许多情况下，中国是其中一些国家最大的贸易伙伴。

sentences.en: So I think that the animosities that we're seeing building up are not as clear cut as they were during the Cold War,
sentences.zh: 所以我认为我们看到的日益增长的敌意并不像冷战时期那样界限分明，

sentences.en: and the relationships are much more complex than what took place between the Western blocs and the Eastern blocs during the height of the Cold War.
sentences.zh: 而且这些关系比冷战高峰时期西方集团和东方集团之间发生的事情要复杂得多。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: The world is just much more complicated than it was back then in that these countries all have their economies deeply intertwined.
sentences.zh: 世界比那时复杂得多，因为这些国家的经济都深度交织在一起。

sentences.en: That's right, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 没错，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: But it's still hard not to draw some parallels between what's going on now and the Cold War that took place between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但仍然很难不将现在发生的事情与美国

sentences.en: and the Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 和苏联之间发生的冷战进行一些类比。

sentences.en: And, you know, there's a funny coincidence taking place in Moscow during this visit by Xi.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，在习近平访问期间，莫斯科发生了一个有趣的巧合。

sentences.en: When Xi and Putin sit down for their formal state dinner, they'll be doing so in the room where Reagan and Gorbachev met many years ago.
sentences.zh: 当习近平和普京坐下来享用正式国宴时，他们将坐在里根和戈尔巴乔夫多年前会面的那个房间里。

sentences.en: And at that point, Reagan and Gorbachev toasted each other and to growing relations between their two countries.
sentences.zh: 当时，里根和戈尔巴乔夫为彼此以及两国之间日益增长的关系举杯祝酒。

sentences.en: Huh.
sentences.zh: 哈。

sentences.en: So it's come full circle, right?
sentences.zh: 所以这又回到了原点，对吧？

sentences.en: History's come back around.
sentences.zh: 历史又转回来了。

sentences.en: Only now, of course, it's Xi and Putin who were toasting each other.
sentences.zh: 只不过现在，当然是习近平和普京在为彼此祝酒。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Those two leaders will be sitting in that room and raising their glasses to each other.
sentences.zh: 这两位领导人将坐在那个房间里，为彼此举杯。

sentences.en: And they'll be toasting to a shared partnership that's aimed in large part at countering American power.
sentences.zh: 他们将为一个在很大程度上旨在对抗美国力量的共同伙伴关系祝酒。

sentences.en: Ed, thank you.
sentences.zh: 埃德，谢谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks a lot, Sabrina.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，萨布丽娜。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Wynna Liu.
sentences.zh: 我是温娜·刘。

sentences.en: I write the game Connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times Games.
sentences.zh: 我编写了《Connections》游戏，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一。

sentences.en: And I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗。

sentences.en: And I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢尝试捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Azersky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·阿泽斯基，我每天创作《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》游戏。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做联觉的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由像你刚才听到的人那样的人制作的。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games 立即开始游戏。

sentences.en: Here's what else you should know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还应该知道的事情。

sentences.en: In France on Monday, President Emmanuel Macron's government narrowly survived a no-confidence vote in Parliament,
sentences.zh: 周一在法国，埃马纽埃尔·马克龙总统的政府在议会的不信任投票中勉强幸存，

sentences.en: clearing the way for a highly controversial bill that would raise the retirement age from 62 to 64 to become law.
sentences.zh: 为一项极具争议的法案扫清了障碍，该法案将退休年龄从62岁提高到64岁，使其成为法律。

sentences.en: Macron had said the law was essential for the future of France's economy.
sentences.zh: 马克龙曾表示，该法律对法国经济的未来至关重要。

sentences.en: But the change struck at a cherished French value, and widespread fury at the law prompted Macron's opponents to take aim at his government with a no-confidence vote.
sentences.zh: 但这一改变触及了法国人珍视的价值观，对该法律的广泛愤怒促使马克龙的反对者通过不信任投票将矛头指向他的政府。

sentences.en: The failure, by just nine votes, sparked more protests across France.
sentences.zh: 以仅九票之差失败，引发了法国各地更多的抗议活动。

sentences.en: And President Biden has issued the first veto of his presidency, rejecting a Republican bill that would prevent the federal government from making investment decisions
sentences.zh: 拜登总统发布了他总统任期内的首次否决令，否决了一项共和党法案，该法案将阻止联邦政府做出投资决策，

sentences.en: based on factors like a company's policy on diversity and carbon emissions.
sentences.zh: 这些决策基于诸如公司在多样性和碳排放方面的政策等因素。

sentences.en: The bill was a direct attack on an increasingly popular investment philosophy, known as ESG.
sentences.zh: 该法案是对一种日益流行的投资理念（即ESG）的直接攻击。

sentences.en: Advocates say it's profitable for businesses, but critics say it is a Trojan horse for liberal values.
sentences.zh: 支持者称这对企业有利可图，但批评者称这是自由主义价值观的特洛伊木马。

sentences.en: Finally, despite a $30 billion rescue package put together last week by the federal government and rival banks, the future of First Republic Bank remained uncertain on Monday.
sentences.zh: 最后，尽管联邦政府和竞争对手银行上周制定了300亿美元的救助计划，但第一共和银行的未来在周一仍然不确定。

sentences.en: Its share price fell by nearly half, and the Times reports that over the past two weeks, its customers have pulled out nearly $70 billion in deposits.
sentences.zh: 其股价下跌了近一半，《时报》报道称，在过去两周内，其客户提取了近700亿美元的存款。

sentences.en: Today's episode was produced by Nina Feldman, Shannon Lynn, and Mirj Zadie.
sentences.zh: 今天的节目由尼娜·费尔德曼、香农·林恩和米尔·扎迪制作。

sentences.en: It was edited by Rachel Quester and Michael Benoit, contains original music by Marian Lozano and Dan Powell, and was engineered by Chris Wood.
sentences.zh: 由雷切尔·奎斯特和迈克尔·贝努瓦编辑，包含玛丽安·洛扎诺和丹·鲍威尔的原创音乐，并由克里斯·伍德进行工程处理。

sentences.en: Our theme music is by Jim Brunberg and Ben Landsverk of Wonderly.
sentences.zh: 我们的主题音乐由Wonderly的吉姆·布伦伯格和本·兰兹维克创作。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是《The Daily》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Sabrina Tavernisi.
sentences.zh: 我是萨布丽娜·塔弗尼西。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter Show》节目中，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客人感到宾至如归的建议。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要完全黑暗才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为那是非常具体的事情。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们是喝咖啡还是喝茶的人？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或您喜欢的任何地方收听《Wirecutter Show》。
